project_type: Flask 2.3.3 monolith (app_clean.py) with blueprints auth.py / admin_routes.py / api_routes.py, Supabase PostgreSQL via psycopg2 (db.py), Jinja templates in templates/, plus a separate legacy SQLite store (smart_weather.db) hand-maintained inside app_clean.py. Flat repo layout: modules live at the repo root as <feature>_<role>.py (totp_auth.py, mfa_crypto.py, supabase_client.py).
build_system: No build step. Dependencies pinned in requirements.txt; the venv at d:\SWS\Smart_weather_system\.venv is already provisioned. Quirks: psycopg2 is NOT installed and no Postgres is reachable, so db.connect() raises DatabaseUnavailable and db.py has NO SQLite backend (do not add one, do not change db.connect()). pyotp==2.10.0 and qrcode==8.2 ARE installed, so totp_auth.is_available() is True and the 2FA routes are live. cryptography==50.0.2 and argon2-cffi==25.1.0 are installed. Never run a bare pip install -r requirements.txt (it pulls the heavy DL/GEE stack).
test_framework: Python stdlib unittest (README: 'uses Python's built-in unittest framework (compatible with pytest)'). Existing fixtures: tests/fake_db.py (FakeDB double for db.connect, asserts placeholder/param counts and refuses SQLite-isms), tests/conftest.py (adds repo root to sys.path), tests/test_mfa_schema_sqlite.py (MFA_SQLITE_DDL - the test-only SQLite translation of supabase/schema.sql section 10 - and make_temp_db()).
build_command: No build. Import smoke check: $env:PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8"; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import db, totp_auth, auth, mfa_crypto"  (do NOT try `import app_clean`: the DL/GEE/psycopg2 deps are absent from .venv).
test_command: $env:PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8"; .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest tests.test_auth_2fa tests.test_admin_security   (the scoped baseline: 79 tests, exactly ONE non-pass). Add new modules to the command as they land, e.g. ... tests.test_totp_replay tests.test_mfa_rate_limit. Phase 1 regression set: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest tests.test_mfa_crypto tests.test_mfa_startup_config tests.test_mfa_schema_sqlite tests.test_rotate_mfa_key -> 54 tests, OK.
verification_instructions: 1) Before editing, re-measure the scoped baseline above and record the numbers. Measured baseline: Ran 79 tests, FAILED (errors=1). That single error is PRE-EXISTING and environmental: tests/test_admin_security.py:430 test_connection_execute_wraps_rows_consistently, TypeError because psycopg2 is absent. Do NOT fix it, do NOT weaken it, and keep it as the only non-pass. 2) After each feature, run the scoped command plus that feature's new test modules and compare against the recorded baseline; no new failure is allowed. 3) Run the Phase 1 regression set to prove nothing additive broke. 4) Do NOT run `unittest discover -s tests`: it imports the DL/GEE modules and takes ~10.6 minutes; at most once, at the very end, and only if time allows. 5) Always set $env:PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8" (a Windows cp1252 console breaks on the emoji print at auth.py:83).
environment_constraints: Windows / PowerShell. Workspace = d:\SWS\Smart_weather_system (there is NO separate git worktree; edit files in place and use ABSOLUTE paths). Interpreter: d:\SWS\Smart_weather_system\.venv\Scripts\python.exe (3.11.9). DO NOT COMMIT and do not push - the user reviews the working tree. NEVER read, print, echo or quote values from .env; reference env var KEY NAMES only (MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY, MFA_IP_PEPPER, SECRET_KEY, MFA_MAX_ATTEMPTS, MFA_LOCKOUT_MINUTES, MFA_IP_SLOWDOWN_AFTER, MFA_LOCKOUT_MAX_MINUTES). NEVER log a TOTP secret, submitted code, recovery code, token, password or raw IP. No Postgres is reachable, so all new tests must be hermetic (temp sqlite3 fixtures and/or FakeDB). MFA_IP_PEPPER is unset in the test environment, so mfa_crypto.ip_hash() raises MfaCryptoError there - new code must degrade to ip_hash=None instead of erroring. Unrelated pre-existing dirty files (edge_case_hardening.py, models/*, package.json, scripts/clean.js, scripts/run-python.js, test_endpoints.py) must be left alone.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md / CONTRIBUTING.md / .kiro/steering in the repo; README.md 'Running Tests' is the only guidance. Project rules for this task come from the brief and the plan: additive and surgical; do not alter existing function signatures, session keys or behaviour beyond what Phase 2/3 explicitly require and list every such change in the report; do not migrate users.totp_secret; do not touch app_clean.py's secret-key handling (audit finding C1 is already FIXED - app_clean.py now calls auth.resolve_secret_key()); no new external network call in the TOTP path; keep auth.login_limiter / signup_limiter / _RateLimiter attribute names (admin_routes.py:152,164,167, tests/test_auth_2fa.py:89 and tests/test_admin_security.py:65 poke them directly); for anything ambiguous use the safest default and mark it TODO(mfa) referencing docs/mfa_threat_model.md. If a requirement conflicts with existing code, STOP and report the conflict instead of guessing.
key_patterns: db.py section 10 ('MFA (Phase 1) accessors', db.py:470-840) is the pattern for new accessors: thin functions over `with transaction() as conn:` / `with connect() as conn:`, %s placeholders only, db.as_utc() for timestamptz params, `::uuid` casts, docstrings stating the arguments are never logged. db.mfa_try_consume_totp_step (db.py:572) is the replay primitive: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (factor_id, time_step) DO NOTHING RETURNING, True only when newly inserted. mfa_events is APPEND-ONLY (only mfa_log_event INSERT and mfa_recent_events SELECT exist, by design). mfa_crypto.py: encrypt_secret/decrypt_secret (MultiFernet), ip_hash(ip)=hex HMAC-SHA256 keyed by MFA_IP_PEPPER (raises MfaCryptoError when the pepper is unset), opaque_hash, token_hash, validate_mfa_config(). auth.py patterns: module-level _RateLimiter instances with blocked/hit/reset, client_ip() = request.remote_addr (no X-Forwarded-For), csrf_valid()/csrf_protect, generic flash messages, _set_pending_2fa/_get_pending_2fa/_clear_pending_2fa cookie-only pending state, start_session() which clears the session. Tests: hermetic, tempfile.mkdtemp + addCleanup(shutil.rmtree), mock.patch.dict(os.environ, ...), locally generated throwaway secrets that are never printed, no network, no DB, no dev credentials.

directory_structure: Repo root holds the Flask app and all feature modules (app_clean.py, auth.py, admin_routes.py, api_routes.py, db.py, totp_auth.py, mfa_crypto.py, notifications.py, supabase_client.py, requirements.txt). templates/ = Jinja templates (templates/admin/ for the admin panel). static/ = JS/CSS. supabase/schema.sql = the single re-runnable Postgres migration script (section 10 = MFA tables). scripts/ = CLI utilities (create_admin.py, rotate_mfa_key.py). tests/ = unittest modules plus fake_db.py. docs/ = design docs incl. mfa_threat_model.md. .agents/tasks/ = phase audits, plans, reports and these FEAT artifacts (NEVER commit these and never place them under a path that a commit would sweep up).
